title: ExternalDataUserAuth - Data API
description: Stores authentication settings for a Salesforce user to access an external system. The external system must be defined in an external data source or a named credential that’s configured to use per-user authentication. This object is available in API version 27.0 and later.

AuthProviderId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
AuthProviderId.description: Salesforce ID of the authentication provider, which defines the service that provides the login process and approves access to the external system.Only users with the “Customize Application” and “Manage AuthProviders” permissions can view this field. This field is available in API version 39.0 and later. This is a relationship field.

ExternalDataSourceId.description: Salesforce ID of the external data source or named credential that defines the external system. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

Password.description: Password portion of the credentials for the Salesforce user to access the external system.

Protocol.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Protocol.description: Specifies whether to use OAuth, password authentication, or no authentication when the user accesses the external system. Additional authentication protocols are supported for the Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon Athena, Snowflake, GraphQL, and OData 4.01 external data sources. AwsSv4 Basic Custom Jwt JwtExchange

UserId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
UserId.description: ID of the Salesforce user who’s accessing the external system. This is a relationship field.

Username.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Username.description: Username portion of the credentials for the Salesforce user to access the external system.

usage:
If you grant users access to the external data source or named credential via permission sets or profiles, those users can manage their own authentication settings. See Store Authentication Settings for External Systems in the Salesforce Help.

These authentication settings enable a Salesforce user to access an external system.
				The external system is defined in Salesforce as one of the following.

External data source—Provides access to external objects, whose data
						is stored outside the Salesforce organization.

Named credential—Enables the user’s actions to trigger authenticated
						callouts to the endpoint that’s specified in the named credential.
